prompt:
Scene:
A square mid-century editorial illustration of an imagined 1960 spaceport luggage bay, camera medium shot, slight overhead angle looking down onto a chrome conveyor system. Cool fluorescent daylight tone, soft shadows. Light halftone grain.

Subject:
A chrome-bodied space-age luggage conveyor with exposed rollers and bright yellow safety stripes along its edge. A line of rounded mid-century suitcases in pastel colors (powder pink, turquoise, ivory, cadmium red) moves along the belt, each with chrome hardware and small brass tag holders. Overhead a chrome claw-arm mechanism carries a bulging round hatbox toward a curving chute. A stylized baggage handler in ivory coveralls and a turquoise flat cap watches the belt with a cheerful thumbs up. Decorative starburst graphics are painted on the wall behind him.

Important details:
Strict atomic-age palette. Suitcases are bulbous rounded forms, not modern rectangular roller bags. Machinery is visibly mechanical: gears, rollers, chrome levers, amber indicator bulbs. Palette accents: cadmium red, bright yellow, turquoise, pink, chrome. Illustration is editorial mid-century magazine painting, not photoreal.

Use case:
Spaceport Vignettes single study 3 of 5, standalone editorial scene.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern roller luggage, no LCD display, no photoreal skin, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
